thread:
Maria Gomez: Quick design review — prompt-sets approval modal + compact scorecard density. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see 'approval-modal/v3')
Sam Patel: Love the compact scorecard but the approve CTA 'Approve & Close' reads ambiguous — are we closing the modal or publishing externally? Suggest 'Approve prompt set' or 'Approve and mark complete'.
Lee Chen: Agree with Sam. Also noticed keyboard focus jumps: the modal CTA gets focus before the confirmation checkbox. That breaks sequential tab flow.
Anya K: Microcopy quick take: avoid 'publish' across product. We use 'rollout' elsewhere — prefer 'Mark as approved' to be consistent with rollout language.
Oliver B: Backend note: current model uses `approved: boolean` only. To support 'request SME review' we need `review_state: [pending, approved, changes_requested]` and an `assignee` field. Migration is straightforward but needs a short schema bump.
Maria Gomez: Visual/accessibility nits: pass/fail chips use green #005E3F and red #FF453A. Contrast check flags the red chip as <3:1 for 12px labels. Can we add an inner icon + 2px darker border to meet AA?
a11y-bot: Automated accessibility scan: Contrast fail on .chip-fail (text-on-fill) — ratio 2.8:1. Suggest darker fill (#C92B25) or white label with bold 600 weight.
Sam Patel: For regression diffs, SR label should be descriptive: 'Regression diffs — 3 changed examples for prompt set X' instead of generic 'diffs'. Helps screen reader context when users land on the list.
Lee Chen: Proposed keyboard focus order for modal: 1) close button 2) diff list container (first item) 3) scorecard controls 4) approval checkbox 5) primary CTA (Approve) 6) secondary (Request changes). Also add visible focus ring for rows and a skip link to jump between diff and scorecard.
Anya K: Tone tweak: primary CTA 'Approve' is OK but add a confirmation microcopy above checkbox: 'Approving will mark this prompt set as approved for deployments.' For ambiguity, include a link 'what happens after approval'.
Oliver B: I'll prototype `review_state` and expose an endpoint `POST /prompt_sets/:id/review` with body {state, assignee, note}. Will gate behind FF `sme-review` and add event to audit log.
Maria Gomez: Action items — Sam: finalize CTA + helper copy by Thu; Lee: create keyboard focus map & aria labels by Wed; Oliver: spike API and FF this sprint; Anya: write the helper copy + confirmation tone variants. I'll update the Figma frames and add comments. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: SGTM — will drop copy options here when ready.
file_notes: Design review thread focused on approval modal copy, accessibility contrast on status chips, keyboard focus order, and backend review-state support. Contains action items and bot scan results.
